text:
Predicates:
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Game(y) ::: y is a game.
Top10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(y) ::: y sells more than one million copies.
Premises:
∃x (JapaneseCompany(x) ∧ Created(x, legendOfZelda) ∧ Game(legendOfZelda)) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀y (Top10(y) → JapaneseCompany(z) for some z who made y) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀y (SellsMoreThanOneMillion(y) → Top10(y)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
¬Top10(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
